scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: Your licence, marksheet and other documents live in one app, and officials accept them. How is DigiLocker trusted?

scenes.name: what
scenes.text: DigiLocker is a government run digital wallet for documents, linked to your Aadhaar and mobile number.

scenes.name: issuers
scenes.text: The key idea is issuers. Departments like transport, and boards, publish documents directly into the system.

scenes.name: fetch
scenes.text: When you open one, the app fetches it from the issuer's records, instead of trusting a photo you uploaded.

scenes.name: sign
scenes.text: Issued documents carry a digital signature, so any change to them can be detected.

scenes.name: share
scenes.text: You can share a document with consent, and the receiver can verify it came from the issuer.

scenes.name: valid
scenes.text: Under Indian rules, these issued documents are treated as valid like originals, though check what a specific office accepts.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Issued, signed, fetched, verified. Follow for more on how things really work.
